description: This file implements the back-end APIs for managing IP interfaces in a COSA Data Model. It includes functions for creating, initializing, removing IP interface objects, and handling registration and configuration of IPv6 prefixes and addresses, with interactions with persistent storage and folder management.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE CosaIPCreate(VOID)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new IP object, returning a handle to it.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaIPInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the IP object, including setting up folders, retrieving current IP interface entries, and preparing internal data structures.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaIPRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Removes the IP object, freeing associated resources and cleaning up system data.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaIpRegGetInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Retrieves current IP interface information from persistent storage and populates internal data structures.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaIPRegAddInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pNextInsNumName,ULONG ulNextInsNum,char * pPreffix,ULONG ulUpperInsNum,char * pAlias,ANSC_HANDLE hCosaContext)
methods.description: Registers a new IP interface information entry into persistent storage.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaIPRegDelInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hCosaContext)
methods.description: Deletes an existing IP interface information entry from persistent storage.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaIPv6PrefGenInstAlias(PCOSA_DML_IP_IF_FULL2 p_ipif,PCOSA_DML_IP_V6PREFIX pEntry)
methods.description: Generates an instance number and alias for a new IPv6 prefix, updating the related configuration storage.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaIPv6AddrGenInstAlias(PCOSA_DML_IP_IF_FULL2 p_ipif,PCOSA_DML_IP_V6ADDR pEntry)
methods.description: Generates an instance number and alias for a new IPv6 address, updating the related configuration storage.

ctags.name: CosaIPRegAddInfo
ctags.signature: (ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pNextInsNumName,ULONG ulNextInsNum,char * pPreffix,ULONG ulUpperInsNum,char * pAlias,ANSC_HANDLE hCosaContext)
